stories.headline: The X-Men Casting Rumors Just Keep on Coming - Gizmodo
stories.summary: All eyes are on the next 'X-Men' movie and what actors Marvel will enlist to help fill out its cast.
stories.why: Marvel's X-Men casting is the industry's biggest puzzle right now—it signals whether Marvel learned from their recent MCU fatigue or if they're repeating the same formula that made you tune out.

stories.headline: Taylor Frankie Paul Called Out for Alleged Courthouse A.I. Photos After Probation Ends - TMZ
stories.summary: Taylor Frankie Paul is getting called out for allegedly posting what appears to be A.I.-generated courthouse photos as she celebrated the end of her 3-year probation.
stories.why: A momfluencer faking court photos with AI to celebrate legal victory isn't just cringe—it's a window into how social media incentivizes deception when accountability actually arrives.

stories.headline: Bill Maher Makes Weight Jokes About Ariana Grande, ‘Real Time’ Audience Groans - Deadline
stories.summary: Bill Maher's two Ariana Grande weight jokes during his opening monologue on Friday's Real Time With Bill Maher were met with mixed audience reactions.
stories.why: Maher's weight jokes bombing with his own audience marks a real cultural shift: the guy who built a brand on 'saying what others won't' is now out of step with people who actually pay to hear him.

stories.headline: I moved to NYC at 22 and found the perfect roommate. She was 70. - businessinsider.com
stories.summary: In NYC, finding a place to live isn't easy. So when William Swanson found the right listing, he jumped on it — even though his new roommate was 70.
stories.why: This isn't quirky—it's a practical answer to housing that's priced out your generation, and it hints at a future where intergenerational living becomes economic necessity, not choice.

stories.headline: Perez Hilton's mental health crisis tests the limits of empathy - usatoday.com
stories.summary: Following Perez Hilton's shocking livestream, the internet is grappling with how to find compassion for a man who once was so cruel.
stories.why: Perez Hilton's breakdown forces you to reckon with whether someone who profited from cruelty deserves redemption, especially when he's still the same guy who built his career destroying others for clicks.

stories.headline: The ghost of “60 Minutes” is about to haunt Bari Weiss - Salon.com
stories.summary: Former correspondents Scott Pelley and Sharyn Alfonsi may be teaming up to get the last word
stories.why: CBS's golden-boy correspondents potentially ganging up on Bari Weiss signals a high-profile fracture in mainstream media's ability to stay unified, even against a common critic.

stories.headline: How Jim James and Jeff Tweedy learned to love the Grateful Dead - NPR
stories.summary: Jim James of My Morning Jacket and Jeff Tweedy of Wilco are two artists who've dipped their toes into the Grateful Dead extended universe through a singular experience: by sharing the stage with Bob…
stories.why: Indie rock's biggest voices embracing the Dead isn't nostalgia—it's admission that Gen X artists see the Dead as the blueprint for longevity and fan loyalty your generation actually respects.
